title: Add difficulty strata: depth, tumour-purity (spike-in), FFPE-like degradation
context: M1 difficulty-stratification for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Extends the simulated truth set with realistic difficulty axes (sequencing depth, tumour purity via spike-in, FFPE-like degradation) so the benchmark measures caller robustness, not just easy cases. All strata are simulated and CC-licensed per the open-data guardrail, with realism assumptions documented for the datasheet.
objective: Augment the sim-101 truth set with parameterised difficulty strata (depth, tumour-purity spike-in, FFPE-like degradation), each labelled and provenance-recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: Each difficulty axis (sequencing depth, tumour purity spike-in fraction, FFPE-like degradation) is parameterised and labelled per case.
Strata membership recorded in each ground-truth manifest so scoring can report n-per-stratum.
Generation method and realism assumptions documented; license CC-BY-4.0/CC0; provenance recorded.
output: data/sim/truthset-v1-strata/ — stratified simulated truth set (depth/purity/FFPE) with labels.
